summary: Full-stack MVP test of nearbyok.com. All 10 pytest backend tests PASS. All requested frontend flows work: home (12 cats + 12 cities, JSON-LD present), hero search navigates correctly to /dentists/florida/miami, listing page renders 11 business cards with rating/distance/open-now/CTAs, Leaflet map with pins renders, filter rating 4.5 reduces results 11->7, Show Number posts lead and reveals real phone, detail page shows all CTAs, 5 FAQ items, hours table, similar businesses, popular categories sidebar, Enquiry modal opens/submits with success state, JSON-LD scripts injected (3 on listing/detail, 1 on home). Google Places live ingest returned inserted=5 for plumbers/austin — real Google API integration verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 570 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider splitting into modules (routes/seed/seo/google_ingest) as the app grows.
server.py line 325: dead-code `oh_map_price` assignment (assigns to unused variable in same statement as price). Harmless but noisy — recommend cleanup.
server.py line 324: `oh_map` defined but never used. Remove.
Using deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'). Migrate to lifespan context manager for forward compatibility.
seed_data_creation: Seed already runs at startup (1134 businesses across 12x12 matrix). Live Google ingest also verified — inserted 5 real places for plumbers/austin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (10 tests, JUnit XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml). BASE_URL sourced from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Twilio intentionally unconfigured — leads fallback to real phone (expected). Google Places live ingest works with the current key.
